g1|variants|dunning and collections.family_title: SAP S/4HANA OTC Dunning and Collections
g1|variants|dunning and collections.summary: This scenario family covers the processes used to monitor overdue customer open items and execute collection strategies. Variants differ based on whether classic FI dunning, integrated collections management, or automated dispute management is deployed.

variants.name: Classic Financial Accounting Dunning
variants.when_used: Standard dunning run initiated in FI-AR to generate reminder letters for overdue customer invoices without advanced debt collection worklists.
variants.key_config: Define dunning areas, dunning intervals, dunning levels, and dunning charges in transaction OBV3 / OBVW.

variants.name: SAP Collections Management (FSCM-COL)
variants.when_used: Proactive receivables management utilizing worklists, collection strategies, and contact history for key accounts.
variants.key_config: Assign customer master to collection segments, define collection strategies, and configure rule groups in FSCM Collections Management.

variants.name: Integrated Dispute Management (FSCM-DIS)
variants.when_used: Handling customer deductions, short-payments, and disputed OTC billing documents tied to collections workflows.
variants.key_config: Configure dispute case types, reason codes, process routes, and integration with SD billing and FI-AR posting.

compare_groups.name: Master Data & Setup
compare_groups.covers: Customer master settings, collection profile assignment, and dunning block indicators.

compare_groups.name: Execution & Processing
compare_groups.covers: Batch jobs, execution transactions, and worklist generation for dunning and collection agents.

compare_groups.name: Correspondence & Output
compare_groups.covers: Form definitions, SAP Script / Smart Forms / Adobe Forms, and output management for dunning notices.

compare_groups.name: Integration & Clearing
compare_groups.covers: Clearing blocks, financial posting effects, and integration with SD credit and billing blocks.
